# Server branding audit

Brand source: [README.md](README.md). Area: `server`. Branch: `branding/server`.

## Changes

- Rebranded API configuration/root status, Swagger/Scalar documentation, OAuth HTML, MCP app diagnostics, Electron server shells, manifests, installer product metadata, logos, favicon/tray/menu/platform artwork and release/source links.
- Rebranded every language in the core email templates, including subjects, signatures, previews, invitations and primary colors; configured the sender as `Base360 <support@base360.ai>`.
- Rebranded tenant/company/project/help-center/integration display seeds and both income/expense CSV datasets; kept organization names distinct and employee-address joins consistent.
- Replaced the old product screenshots used as seeded feature/report/screenshot previews with supplied Base360 artwork. These are brand placeholders rather than screenshots of a rebuilt UI; imported paths remain unchanged.
- Rebranded server plugin errors, success text, AI provider labels/prompts and sync output. Legacy sync title/comment markers remain readable. Existing-password checks still recognize both legacy and Base360 seeded accounts.
- Set root env sample branding, company/social/legal/download defaults and desktop identity/release defaults. Removed social/mobile/extension links with no Base360 equivalent. Retained env names, local development hosts, database/storage/queue identities and trust boundaries.
- Added `.github/workflows/docker-build-publish-base360.yml`: pushes to `base360` build the existing API and webapp Dockerfiles and publish `latest` and commit-SHA tags to `ghcr.io/tasnimultheflex/base360-time-api` and `ghcr.io/tasnimultheflex/base360-time-webapp`. The webapp compiles this fork's source, uses Base360 build-time desktop identity values, and has Base360 image defaults for runtime bundle substitution. Compose API/webapp image references now use those repositories.

## Verification

- All 207 changed TypeScript files parsed with Node's TypeScript parser; no project build or installation was run.
- Changed JSON/YAML parsed; env key lists match their originals. Workflow assertions cover branch trigger, permissions, both matrix images, Dockerfile paths, production/non-demo args and GHCR tags.
- Assert checks passed for legacy/new sync title/comment markers and published-password detection with changed/current/default account addresses and deduplication. Existing Jest assertions were updated for changed output; the suites were not run because dependencies are absent.
- Replacement raster assets decoded successfully; SVG/ICNS/icon files derive from the supplied Base360 assets. `git diff --check` passed.
- The exact brief grep was run recursively over owned paths, excluding `node_modules`; i18n JSON and `*-ui` packages are excluded from this area's ownership. The inventory below accounts for every remaining matching line, grouped by file and reason. It includes required source/release URLs whose repository name intentionally remains `ever-gauzy`.

## Remaining user-visible copy / integration handoff

No old brand remains in the owned presentation strings or owned logo artwork. These explicit boundaries still apply:

- `packages/mcp-server/src/lib/mcp-server.ts:237` hardcodes the advertised MCP server name `gauzy-mcp-server`, and that package contains additional tool descriptions/startup text. `packages/mcp-server` is outside the assigned owned paths, so its owner must rebrand it. The owned MCP shells/configuration are rebranded.
- Upstream author/copyright notices remain in package metadata as required by rule 2. Technical identifiers (API routes, enums, tool names, data-format markers and schema keys) remain as required by rule 1; a raw API/schema/export consumer can inspect those identifiers.
- The supplied source/release repository intentionally retains `TasnimulTheFlex/ever-gauzy`. Optional external-service protocol endpoints and authentication-domain allowlists remain unchanged; their remote responses/content are not rewritten here.
- Previously stored tenant/org names, templates, uploaded images and synced content are not migrated or deleted. The new defaults apply to new seeds/builds. The integrator must test the merged build and deployed configuration; this task does not publish images or push commits.
- Shared UI libraries, webapp code, i18n JSON, `packages/mcp-server`, other unowned packages and deployment entrypoints/scripts were not edited. Their owners must supply the rest of the white label before release.
